method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; focus: the provisions a person bringing or answering a workers' compensation or work-injury damages claim meets. A seat-neutral core (wcrr-core.l4, with 4 regulative rules: s 115(4), s 130, ss 131-132, ss 136-137) and the injured worker's seat layer (wcrr-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (out-of-scope inputs answer NOTHING or a named 'does not apply' value, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Workers' Compensation and Rehabilitation Regulation 2025 (Qld) sl-2025-0116, the version in force from 1 September 2025 and current on 20 October 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/sl-2025-0116.txt; with QOTE for 2026-27 ($1,994.50) from the Workers' Compensation and Rehabilitation (QOTE) Notice 2026 (sl-2026-0044), deposited in its own subject; Act ss 36EB-36ED, 140, 306M(1) and 306R(2) borrowed as facts or a fixed figure

checks.result: 243 assertions satisfied (wcrr-cases.l4 243 of 243), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-11-07); 3 #TRACEs with an expect line (breaches by the registered person, s 115(4), and the insurer, ss 130(3), 132(3)), each read and as expected
